app.name: All-Star Party
app.long_description:
A party board game for 1-4 players: roll the dice, grab coins, buy Star Coins and battle it out in 17 minigames.
Controls: hold the Wii Remote sideways (2 = OK, 1 = back, + = pause/start). Nunchuk, Classic Controller and GameCube controllers work too. HOME quits to the Homebrew Channel. Up to 4 players, each with their own controller. If your TV cuts off the edges, use TV Borders on the title menu.
A fan-made game for private use.
